title: Engine acceleration
objective: To demonstrate that the simulated engine acceleration conforms to the validation data.
initial_conditions_catalog: Flt cond: Approach or Landing | Alt[ft]: 2000 | IAS[kts]: 80 | Flaps: 0 | Throttle[%]: 5
duration_note: Test runs for 21 seconds total (5.0 s baseline hold + 16.0 s post-movement response).
report_format: 5-page official engine report (Page 1: Initial Conditions, Page 2: Group 1 Airspeed/Altitude, Page 3: Group 2 Throttle/RPM, Page 4: Group 3 Power/Fuel, Page 5: Ti/Tt Response Analysis)
tolerance_catalog: ± 10% Ti or ± 0.25 s | ± 10% Tt (Ti: 10% response, Tt: 90% go-around power)
runtime_configuration: Existing main.py test settings and common engine remain authoritative; changes only via test settings dialog
